candidates.draft_title: Add bulk archive action to Members list
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Deborah: When I archive people going forward, is there a bulk way to do it, or is it one at a time? Because I did those 220 one by one last week and it took forever, which is partly why I forgot I'd done it — my brain melted.
[EXTERNAL] Deborah: You're telling me I archived 220 people individually when I could have selected them all and done it once.
[EXTERNAL] Deborah: Small consolation for my clicking finger, but I'll take it. Bulk archive. Noted, next to "archive is not delete" on the sticky note.
